$comment: Thresholds are DATA, not code, so they can be shown in Settings and changed without a release. Every band boundary here is a CHOICE, not a measurement: no real churn data has been used to calibrate them. See docs/decisions/how-it-works.md. The unit of `band` is 0 (not present) to 3 (severe).

usage_drop_30d.label: Usage down
usage_drop_30d.template: Average daily active users fell {absChangePct}% over the last 30 days ({current} vs {baseline}).

usage_rise_30d.label: Usage up
usage_rise_30d.template: Average daily active users rose {changePct}% over the last 30 days ({current} vs {baseline}).

usage_drop_7d.label: Usage down this week
usage_drop_7d.template: Active users this week are {absChangePct}% below the previous four weeks ({current} vs {baseline}).

tickets_up_30d.label: Support tickets up
tickets_up_30d.template: Support tickets rose from {baseline} to {current} in the last 30 days{urgentClause}.

seat_util_low.label: Seats under-used
seat_util_low.template: {used} of {purchased} seats were used in the last 7 days ({pct}%).

payment_failed.label: Payment failed
payment_failed.template: A payment of {amount} due {date} has failed {attempts} time(s).

champion_inactive.label: Champion inactive
champion_inactive.template: The champion ({role}) has not been active for {days} days.

pricing_interest.label: Pricing interest
pricing_interest.template: The pricing page was viewed {n} time(s) in the last 14 days.

data_stale.label: Data is stale
data_stale.template: Usage data ends on {lastDay}, {days} days before today.

severity.$comment: Score is the sum of the bands of the signals a rule matched. Severity is derived from it deterministically; the model's own severity is recorded but never overrides this.
